scope: Corrections to read-only integration scout, based on parent tool output

efi_firmware.action: Use the existing project firmware after fresh hash check; no package install required

other_integration_rules: Do not modify dt25-baseline.json or frozen sources to extend them: create a separate candidate audit/manifest.
Canonical new output is /home/builder/uki-v2-dt25, consistent with existing revision-aware harnesses; dt24 fallback remains untouched.
No new squashfs is needed if actual existing squashfs provides required runtime dependencies and remains byte-exact. RAM-overlay staging is the design; audit SFS contents, not only mutable imgroot.
Verify systemd graph on the real staged overlay fixture; bare imgroot lacks new overlay units and cannot prove their graph.
Packed ash validation must exercise real mountpoint/findmnt and a fixture-only actual overlay in a private mount namespace. Cowspace existence/stat device ID is not an FSTYPE substitute.
QEMU ramfb device availability is only feasibility. Actual simpledrm registration must be measured. VM lacks target TSENS: correct graph flag behavior is safe refusal, never fake native temperatures.

A supervisor SIGKILL chaos gate cannot be replaced by a normal systemctl stop: those are different behaviors. Use an isolated VM with clearly labeled fake private payload if needed; never kill host/native services.
Serialize build/validation/QEMU via a held flock, preserve fresh tags and real exit codes, and independently verify all artifact provenance before media discussion.
No physical USB filesystem repair/write or firmware clear/rearm is authorized in local candidate integration.
